name: RBI FREE-AI Framework (2025)
source: Reserve Bank of India, FREE-AI Committee Report (August 2025): 7 Sutras, 26 recommendations
changelog: 2025.1.0: migrated from sutras.validator.ts with the Phase 0 corrected recommendation references; results unchanged.
2025.1.0 (Phase 1): organisation-level Rec 14 policy-contents clause (ORG scope, behind the AIMS flag).
2025.1.0 (Phase 2): Rec 15 data lifecycle, Rec 20 red team after escalation, Rec 10 training and Rec 24 framework review, each behind its Phase 2 flag (advisory).

clauses.name: Trust is the Foundation
clauses.gap: No board-approved AI policy reference. REC 14 mandates a board-approved AI policy.

clauses.name: People First
clauses.gap: MEDIUM/HIGH risk model without human oversight. REC 16 requires human-in-the-loop.

clauses.name: Innovation over Restraint
clauses.gap: Autonomous model without defined scope boundary. REC 16 requires clear autonomous action limits.

evidence.bias_test: Bias-test report attached as evidence artifact
evidence.declared: Fairness sutra declared in model registration

gap.needs_evidence: No bias-test evidence attached. MEDIUM/HIGH risk requires a documented bias-test artifact, not a declaration.
gap.not_declared: Fairness & Equity sutra not declared. Bias testing must be documented.

clauses.name: Accountability
clauses.gap: No accountability chain (owner team) defined. REC 14 requires the AI policy to set out accountability.

clauses.name: Understandable by Design
clauses.gap: No explainability mechanism declared for MEDIUM/HIGH risk model (Sutra 6: Understandable by Design).

gap.no_red_team: {tier} risk model with no red-team exercise on record. REC 20 asks for red teaming at a frequency proportionate to risk, and after material changes.
gap.red_team_stale: {tier} risk model last red teamed {redTeamAge} days ago; REC 20 interval for {tier} risk is {redTeamInterval} days.
gap.no_drill: {tier} risk model with no passed BCP drill on record. REC 21 requires business-continuity plans for AI systems to be tested.
gap.drill_overdue: {tier} risk model's last passed BCP drill was {drillAge} days ago; the drill interval is {drillInterval} days (REC 21).

clauses.name: Board-approved AI Policy Contents

evidence.pass: AI policy approved {approved_at} with every Rec 14 section
evidence.review_overdue: AI policy is past its review date

clauses.gap: Rec 14 asks for a board-approved AI policy covering governance, accountability, risk appetite, safeguards, auditability, consumer protection, disclosures, lifecycle and liability.

evidence.pass: {linked} dataset(s) registered with lawful basis, provenance and no open deletion order

gap.none: Rec 15 asks for governance over the data lifecycle: link this model's datasets in the data register.
gap.lawful_basis: A linked dataset has no lawful basis or DPDP consent reference.
gap.provenance: A linked dataset has no provenance.
gap.deletion: A linked dataset has an open deletion order.
gap.not_assessed: The data register is not switched on.

gap.escalation: Rec 20 asks for red teaming after material changes: a risk escalation was seen on {required_since} ({reason}) and no red-team exercise is recorded since.
gap.missing: A red-team exercise is required before this high-risk system goes live and none is recorded.
gap.not_assessed: The red-team rules are not switched on.

clauses.name: Capacity Building and Training

evidence.pass: {compliant} of {staff} staff in date on mandatory AI training

clauses.gap: Rec 10 asks for AI capacity building: run mandatory AI training and record completions ({overdue} overdue).

clauses.name: Periodic Review of the AI Framework

evidence.overdue: Last review {last_review} is older than {months} months

clauses.gap: Rec 24 asks for the AI framework and policy to be reviewed at least every {months} months: approve a new AI policy version or record a management review.
